d: Prasar bharti aur IIT jammu ne bhartiy bhashaon men svadeshi AI kshamtaon ke vikas ke lie projekt MIRA ke tahat samjhauta gyapan par hastakshar kie. MoU par prasar bharti ke mukhy karyakari adhikari (CEO) aur IIT jammu ke nideshak ne hastakshar kie. is avsar par prasar bharti abhilekhagar evan OTT ke up mahanideshak bhi upasthit rahe. pariyojna ke tahat aakashvani aur durdarshan ki abhilekhiy odiyo-vijual samagri se detaset taiyar kar bhartiy bhasha evan spich AI modal ko behtar banaya jaega.
